sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Nineteen selected parameters, including assumed pressure-driven liquid-water mobility and pore-wall radiation. Permeability fixed at 3.75e-14 m2 and pore radius at 5.9e-6 m; inlet atmosphere, liquid latent contrast and transition width also fixed. Eight paired samples do not establish all-parameter, retention-model, pore-size-range or permeability-range robustness. Earlier ensembles remain historical.
